title: Dublin street-block recede (the DEFAULT map's node surface) is mutation-vacuous — no test anywhere catches its deletion
evidence:
dublin.odin:359-366:
	col := fam
	col.a = u8(f32(col.a) * crisis_recede_scale(recede))
	...
	edge := fam
	edge.a = u8(90 * crisis_recede_scale(recede))

EMPIRICAL (mutation leg, this review): with both recede lines neutered (col.a = u8(f32(col.a) * 1); edge.a = u8(90 * 1)) the harness printed:
  PASS dublin_board         ticks=1800
  palcheck: all green
 — dublin_board.dem captures only 30000ms/90000ms and its 90s crisis is pool-only (factor 0); palcheck §7 runs the procedural map. The only Dublin-map demo is dublin_board (grep -l dublin demos/*.dem). map_source_test.odin:15 pins that the default map IS dublin: "testing.expect(t, src == MAP_SOURCE_DEFAULT, "unset PP_MAP must default to dublin")"
detail: A shipping behavior on the default board — blocks/frontage recede during a real Saturated_Bundle crisis — has zero unit, palcheck, or golden coverage; deleting it leaves every gate green.
recommended_fix: Add a palcheck §7 leg (or a crisis-carrying dublin golden capture): render the Dublin board fixture with a Saturated_Bundle row and pixel-scan a non-involved block for the faded alpha vs the involved one.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: Mutation legs run this review (harness output, read verbatim): factor bypass -> "palcheck: 6 check(s) FAILED" (spec's headline RED claim holds, 6 checks not 5); halo raw-revert -> "FAIL juice - T2 65000ms: 1985/921600 pixels differ"; lane recede removal -> "FAIL juice ... 22134/921600 pixels differ"; router recede removal -> "FAIL juice ... 1479/921600 pixels differ"; baseline "odin test app/render" -> "Finished 100 tests ... All tests were successful". BUT the Dublin block recede deletion -> "PASS dublin_board" + "palcheck: all green" (see companion finding).
detail: P0 100% (factor/draw-path/inert byte-identity mutation-proven), overall >80%, but P1 ≈85–89%: the default-map (Dublin) node-accent recede surface has 0% coverage, and the fan-stub/primitive variants are unreachable.
recommended_fix: Close the Dublin-block gap (one palcheck leg or one crisis-carrying dublin golden); P1 returns ≥90% and the gate flips to PASS.

title: Fan-stub recede is unreachable in every test config (7.5 flags pinned off)
detail: The fan-stub recede lines added by this diff cannot execute under any current test; a mutation there is vacuous by construction (the branch itself is un-blessed by the 7.5 verdict).
recommended_fix: When a future ruling flips route_wires/wire_anchors, extend palcheck §7 with a count>1 fixture scanning a non-involved fan stub for the receded tier hex.

title: crisis_packet_involvement_chain leaks the loaded Catalogs — breaks the spawn_fx_test convention it cites
evidence: odin test app/render output: "[WARN ] --- <101.50KiB/166.70KiB> ... :: render.crisis_packet_involvement_chain" + "+++ leak 17B @ ... [catalog.odin:834:catalogs_load()]". The test cites "// the on-disk catalogs (the spawn_fx_test load convention, self-contained)" and has "defer pp.run_destroy(&state)" but no catalogs_destroy; spawn_fx_test.odin:115 pairs every load: "defer pp.catalogs_destroy(&cat)".
detail: The new test omits its cited convention's defer, leaving ~100KiB of catalog arrays per run; odin's tracker WARNs now and the allocator-noise precedent grows.
recommended_fix: Add `defer pp.catalogs_destroy(&cat)` after catalogs_load in crisis_packet_involvement_chain (line ~403).

title: PR-body verification accounting drifts from disk: 6 goldens changed vs 5 table rows; 100 tests run vs '99/99 (94 + 5 new)'
evidence: _pr_body_viscomm_crisis_duck.md:59 "Exactly **6 crisis-carrying T2 frames**" but the table rows only: "| `goldens/juice/65000ms.png` |", "| `goldens/a11y_{deutan,protan,tritan}/65000ms.png` |", "| `goldens/a11y_reduced/65000ms.png` |" (5). git diff --name-only ec1e41e^ HEAD -- goldens/ lists 6 incl. "goldens/a11y_scale/65000ms.png". Line 123: "| `odin test app/render` | 99/99 (94 + 5 new) |" but the suite runs "Finished 100 tests ... All tests were successful" (6 new tests: purity, byte-identity, calm-register, predicates, chain, route_tie).
detail: The re-bless cause table omits a11y_scale (changed on disk) and the test count under-reports the new tests by one — reviewers auditing the corpus against the PR body will see discrepancies.
recommended_fix: Add the a11y_scale row to the golden table and correct the verify row to 100/100 (94 + 6 new).
